newsitem.title: FRANCE: GAN endorses Pfeiffer as new head.
newsitem.headline: GAN endorses Pfeiffer as new head.

text.p: French state-owned insurer GAN said on Tuesday that it was accepting the nomination of Didier Pfeiffer to replace Jean-Jacques Bonnaud as chairman.
The government said on November 27 that it was firing Bonnaud and naming Pfeiffer to replace him.
The board of GAN "proposed to the government the nomination of Mr Didier Pfeiffer as chairman of the board," GAN said in a statement.

The rare firing of a state-appointed chairman by decree followed a government decision in mid-November to scrap a tender for the privatisation of GAN bank unit CIC and charges by French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis that Bonnaud and CIC chairman Bernard Yoncourt failed to promote the sale.
